notes.title: "Paint by Words" is coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40322544/0e0c897496703ce0338147882b3175fecac57196.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings to all Gizmos lovers![/b]

I am happy to announce that my new game [b]Paint by Words[/b] will be released soon!

Genre: Relaxing Word Puzzle

The game is a fun and educational combination of Hangman and Crossword, plus some PbN vibe :) Fill in the missing letters in the crossword puzzles to unveil distinct regions of one big pixel art. Use your brain power to convert boring grayscales into colorful pixel art fellows!

You can find full info on the game's Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3798420/Paint_by_Words/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36421428/8822a28bc3668ea4658a4aa109e164e07207f30a.png[/img]
Best Regards,
Oleg Sereda

notes.title: NONOGRAMS has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36421428/a4a924cc3a6139ca4a5a0d398fd27a55b6557643.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings to all Gizmos lovers![/b]

I am happy to announce that my new game [b]Nonograms[/b], the successor of the Gizmos series, has been released!
I've used all my knowledge and experience about nonograms, to make the game as perfect as possible.
It is a free-to-play game with DLCs (at the lowest possible prices).
There are a big bunch of new ideas and improvements in comparison with the original Gizmos games. 
You can find full info on the game's Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2622750/Nonograms/


Best Regards,
Oleg Sereda

notes.title: Version 1.2 has been released!
notes.content:
What's new:

- Relaxed game mode. No more timers and level defeats through a lot of mistakes. You may enable it on Options screen.
- New shiny effects  on riddles rows completing.
- Better game fonts representation. 
- Antivirus false detection has been fixed.
- Lot of minor bugs fixed.

Hope you will enjoy it!

Best Regards,
Oleg Sereda
